create_mptconfig_default: create a default MptConfig instance with standard model parameters for the MPT transformer architecture
create_mptconfig_custom: create a MptConfig instance with custom hyperparameters including d_model, n_heads, n_layers, and vocab_size
create_mptattentionconfig: create an MptAttentionConfig instance to configure attention settings like attn_type, attn_pdrop, and alibi bias
create_mptconfig_with_attn_dict: create a MptConfig instance passing attn_config as a dictionary that gets converted to MptAttentionConfig
review_mptconfig_post_init: review the MptConfig.__post_init__ method that initializes attn_config from dict or default MptAttentionConfig
